title: RAW UNREVIEWED: f83r coupled-system labels mix part names with relation instructions
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. GDT790 fixes four local labels and two main plus two embedded records in the lower f83r coupled system. GDT1032 reads both collum matric[?], a plausible named anatomical part, and three similiter hic relational inscriptions on one historical diagram. Freeze the f83r physical owner graph and all complete records. A mixed-grammar interpretation predicts that at least one label is referential and depends on another labeled place, while a pure inventory assigns each label an independent component; the relation must be observable in the full record and graph. This is distinct from general panel reset or a positional caption count. No target label is independently translated; raw unreviewed and untested.

design.mechanism: coexisting nominal part labels and cross-place instructions partition one coupled diagram
design.unit: f83r lower coupled panel, its four labels and all four complete records
design.contrast: mixed part-name plus reference grammar versus four independent part names
design.prediction: Mixed grammar needs an independently constrained antecedent and repeated property; pure inventory needs four separately owned components. Without that constraint, retain both.
